name: Financial-Intelligence-Strategy-Agent
description: An autonomous business intelligence agent specializing in Canadian demographic shifts and consumer behavior. The agent pulls and analyzes public data to help financial institutions design products, assess credit risks, and optimize regional branch or digital-first strategies.

paragraphs: An autonomous business-intelligence agent that turns Canadian public demographic and housing data into executive retail-banking strategy briefs. It pulls live figures from Statistics Canada, CMHC, and the Bank of Canada, then synthesizes them into a structured brief that maps demographic and cost-of-living realities to specific banking product opportunities — served three ways: a hosted web generator, an MCP tool server, and a one-command CLI. Built as part of My AI Portfolio alongside the AI-Native Team Diagnostic and the Enterprise RAG Assistant.
Reports empirical trend realities only. It does not forecast interest rates or market crashes, and does not provide legal, compliance, or FINTRAC/Bank Act regulatory advice.
